correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 verified line-by-line: v=(y,1) has below-neighbour on axis e5 (infected by hypothesis) and above-neighbour on the same axis e5, so under the >=2-distinct-axes rule v fires iff >=1 of its 8 in-layer neighbours (axes e1..e4) is infected; above-layer state provably contributes no new axis, so L1 dynamics is closed r=1 bootstrap in the full dynamics with no idealization. On the connected periodic 4D torus fill-iff-initially-nonempty follows (spread within diam<=2n for n>=3; degenerate n=1,2 irrelevant to n->infinity scope). Corollary (1-p)^A follows exactly from S=empty under product initialization; -logP/(pA)->1 verified numerically. S-rule (1-p)^{2A} correctly stated as exact only under frozen-above idealization and as an upper bound in full dynamics (more help can only lower failure probability), so the bound direction is correct. Surface arithmetic recomputed independently: 18*2^{-4/5}=10.33828 vs cube 10.0, +3.38%, refuting the gamma=2 optimizer clause. Monte Carlo is honestly labeled evidence-not-proof with Wilson intervals; spot predictions fall inside intervals. DRAFT scope limits are explicit; no window or expansion overclaim.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route verified: the lemma arose necessarily from attacking the target droplet-expansion clause (which neighbours supply the second axis) plus checking the gamma=2 parenthetical, documented in target_exit.json, and is reported honestly as strictly weaker than the blocked window with no window claim. Monotone domination P_D<=P_S goes the wrong way and does not imply the exact face law. No database, census, table, dual/complement encoding, or broader theorem was found that substantively implies or exhaustively covers the headline. Adversarial checks below record the concrete searches and why each fails to cover the claim.

value.rationale: The headline is a rigorously proved exact local law for the admitted target's own novel rule plus an exact arithmetic refutation of its gamma=2 optimizer clause — not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Object and invariant were motivated before computation by the target droplet-expansion clause; the exact (1-p)^A law and 1-vs-2 exponent split were not known or mechanically implied by standard r-neighbour results (which concern a different, easier rule); any future droplet/threshold analysis of this rule must use this one-step face law, and the 3.38% correction prevents wasted effort on the wrong geometry. The report further interprets the lemma by diagnosing the target blockage (per-slab constant gap 1-exp(-A^4 c), transverse rescue missing) and honestly scoping the open multi-slab problem. Judged as a self-contained headline separately from the unfinished census, it is the kind of exact invariant of a specific natural object the STANDARD expressly deems eligible without demanding a new general theorem.
